## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: ...`, `fix(scope): ...`)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, config or setup changed
- [ ] Schema changes are a **new** numbered migration (no edits to applied migrations)
- [ ] If the API changed: `docs/design.md` §5 and `src/shared/api.ts` are both updated
- [ ] No message content, addresses, tokens or secrets are logged
